Seen 'Mo Amer: Mohammed in Texas' on Netflix? Houston, you're in for a treat.

Mo Amer brings his sharp wit back home. From his days in an ESL class to starring in 'Mo,' his humor is as real as it gets. Stories of life as a Palestinian-American refugee? He's lived it. Mo's observational style is both funny and eye-opening. Catch him live. You won't regret it.
